summary: Output [] instead of hint text to stdout when --json is set and results are empty.
reason: Five commands (articles, open-access, search, trends, reading-list ls) wrote a human-readable hint to stderr and returned nil with no stdout output when the local corpus was empty; this left stdout empty and caused json_fidelity dogfood tests to fail with 'invalid JSON'. Also added Example field to reading-list ls which was missing.
validated_outcome: Full live dogfood gate passes with 0 failures after this fix.
